nodes.long_description:
# Train Like a Real Boxer

Boxing Drills VR brings authentic pad training to your Quest. No gym required.

**Realistic Drills**

Follow a virtual trainer through classic boxing combinations:
- **1-2 (Jab-Cross)** - The fundamental combo
- **1-2-Duck** - Add defensive movement
- **1-2-3** - Jab, Cross, Hook
- **1-2-3-2** - Extended combinations
- **Uppercut combos** - Work those body shots
- **Growing Library** - A vast selection of drills with new content added regularly!

**Built for Performance**

We know every millisecond counts when you're in the pocket.
- Low-Latency Precision: Built from the ground up for high-performance tracking.
- Native Feel: Optimized to ensure smooth, responsive feedback that feels like hitting real pads.

**Get Scored**

Every session tracks your performance:
- **Power** - Hit those pads hard
- **Speed** - Quick reactions matter
- **Agility** - Duck and weave like a pro
- **Form** - Return to guard after every punch

**Train Your Way**
- Multiple drill durations (30s to 3 min)
- Choose the speed that suits you (slow, medium, fast, progressive, variable)
- Passthrough mode - train safely in your own space

**Perfect For**
- Beginners learning boxing basics
- Fitness enthusiasts wanting a fun workout
- Experienced boxers staying sharp

No experience needed. Just clear some space, put on your Quest, and start throwing punches.

**Shape the Future (Open Source)**

We believe the best training tools are built by the community. We are moving toward an open-source model so the community can help us shape the roadmap of the product.
nodes.short_description: Train like a boxer in VR. Follow realistic pad drills with jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Practice defense with duck-and-weave combos. Track your power, speed, and form after every session.

nodes.change_log:
### v0.16.0

**Heavy Bag Mode**
- New **HEAVY BAG** drill category with three sessions: 1 min, 3 min, and 5 min
- Freeform striking — no prompts, no expected punches, just hit the bag
- Realistic pendulum physics: bag swings forward, laterally, and rotates based on punch direction and speed
- Bag cylinder tilts to follow its pendulum arc (no more vertical-only cylinder)
- Punch type auto-detected from glove velocity direction at impact:
  - Forward dominant → Jab / Cross
  - Lateral dominant → Left / Right Hook
  - Lateral + downward angle → Left / Right Body Hook
  - Upward dominant → Left / Right Uppercut
- End-of-round stats: total punches, best combo streak, per-punch-type count and average speed, overall average and hardest punch

**Peek-a-Boo Drills**
- Three new Tyson-style peek-a-boo defense drills:
  - **HOOK & DUCK** — Right Hook, duck the counter Left Hook (intro drill)
  - **PEEK-A-BOO HOOKS** — Alternating Right Hook → duck → Left Hook → duck rhythm
  - **PEEK-A-BOO POWER** — Full sequence: Jab → Right Hook → duck → Jab → Left Hook → duck

**Reflex Bar Redesign**
- Duck bar completely redesigned as a pivot-based reflex bar
- Fixed pivot at trainer position; long thin cylinder (1.5 m) rotates around it like a boom arm
- Bar stays aligned along its own length throughout the swing — no more spinning
- Collision uses closest-point-on-line-segment geometry — accurate anywhere along the bar's length
- Can no longer be escaped by leaning back

### v0.15.0

**Tutorial & Setup**
- Tutorial renamed to "Tutorial & Setup" — now covers training configuration as well as punch onboarding
- New **Training Setup** step (step 3, before punch reference) lets you configure:
  - Difficulty league (Beginner / Amateur / Pro) with one-line descriptions of each
  - Music track (Off or one of five tracks) and volume
  - Body weight class (calibrates punch scoring thresholds)
  - Pad height offset (physical fit calibration)
- Hook position test mode split into separate **LEFT HOOK (3)** and **RIGHT HOOK (4)** buttons — only one pad appears at a time so they don't overlap, and the pad shows the correct punch number (3 or 4) instead of the entity number
- Tutorial pads are now hidden when at rest — no more dark red squares blocking the UI text
- Music track changes in the tutorial take effect immediately (previous track stops, new track starts)
- "Restart Tutorial & Setup" moved from Settings to the **Controls / Help popup** (the ? button), alongside the guide link

**Settings Reorganisation**
- Settings tab reorganised into five collapsible sections replacing the previous flat list:
  - **DIFFICULTY** (open by default) — league, speed, duration, speed threshold, power threshold, speed pressure
  - **MUSIC** (open by default) — track selector, volume slider
  - **PHYSICAL FIT** (open by default) — southpaw, weight class, pad height offset, mirror pads, hook offset
  - **FOOTWORK** (collapsed) — lateral, depth, and angle footwork with amount sliders
  - **DISPLAY & SCORING** (collapsed) — body scoring, body engagement mode, mixed reality, hit feedback toggles
- With the three open sections the page fits without scrolling; less-used sections stay out of the way

### v0.14.0

**Interactive Tutorial**
- New step-by-step tutorial for first-time players, launching automatically on first install
- Walks through all 8 punch types (1–8) with real numbered pads and technique cues for each
- Teaches your first combo (1-2: Jab + Cross) with both pads live and lit in sequence
- Covers basic defense: ducking a hook and slipping a straight punch
- Pads match the real drill experience — numbered faces, correct orientation per punch type (hooks sideways, uppercuts tilted), and punch direction validation so wrong punch types don't count
- Pads retract after each hit and return to offer position so you can keep practicing each punch at your own pace
- Stance selection (Orthodox / Southpaw) is baked into the tutorial and saves to settings
- Tutorial can be restarted any time via Settings → Restart Tutorial

### v0.13.0

**Punch-Type Sound Effects**
- Hits now sound different based on what you're throwing and how hard:
  - Body shots → dull thud (hit_body)
  - Hooks and uppercuts at high velocity → cracking power hits (hit_power)
  - Jabs and crosses → sharp crack (hit_crack)
  - Slower punches → solid contact (hit_solid)
- Two variants per category play randomly so no two combos sound identical
- Smash threshold scales with weight class — heavyweights trigger power sounds more easily

**Fighter Card: Dual Stat Bars**
- Each punch-type stat now shows two stacked bars instead of one:
  - Top bar — raw speed grade, independent of confidence/sample size
  - Bottom bar — experience level (number of sessions with this punch type logged)
- A legend below the bars explains both axes
- Gives a clearer picture of reliability vs. peak performance

**Opponent Height Offset**
- New setting to shift all pads up or down in 5 cm steps (±20 cm range)
- Simulates training against a taller or shorter opponent
- Useful for calibrating to your own height or adding variety to sessions

**Workout Focus**
- New Focus setting in the Workout tab: cycle through Mixed, Combinations, Head Movement, Counter Punching, or Footwork
- When a focus is active it overrides the manual category toggles and restricts drill selection to the relevant drill pool — giving each session a clear purpose
- Mixed (default) keeps existing behaviour with the manual category toggles

**New Drill: 1-1-2-7-3**
- Double Jab, Cross, Left Body Hook, Check Hook — 45 second drill
- Teaches the outfighter/technician game:
  - First jab measures range, second feints and closes the gap
  - Cross is the money punch — power weighted heavily in scoring
  - Left body hook adds a level change targeting the liver
  - Check hook finishes the sequence, stopping forward pressure and catching them coming in
